name: POST /api/projects/:projectId/citations/check - run citation gate v2 over a text
description: Citation gate v2 (Architecture §9), no off switch. Client sources are cited [C:<file_version_id>#<location ordinal>], FDA passages [R:<record>#<passage>]. Resolve: each citation must point at a passage of a file in this project (a superseded version is kept with a warning). Match: quoted words must appear in the cited text, and every number, unit, standard edition, date and K-number must equal a fact extracted from a cited location. Cover: a sentence with a value, standard, date, material or method needs a citation. Failing sentences are removed and returned with a code (UNCITED, UNRESOLVED, QUOTE_MISMATCH, VALUE_MISMATCH) and the run is logged; refused=true when no cited statement survives. The happy path checks a draft with an uncited value, which is removed and the answer refused. Covers: an answer without a citable passage is refused and uncited sentences are dropped; values must equal an extracted fact or the sentence is removed; a citation to a superseded version is flagged.

errorCases.when: no project with this id in the firm
empty text, text over 50,000 characters or unknown route
